class.name: KomsoftGw
class.brief_description: Singleton client for the KomSoft Gateway leaderboard API.

method.name: configure
method.description: Sets the connection parameters used by every subsequent call. [code]base_url[/code] is the gateway root (a trailing slash is trimmed automatically), [code]service[/code] is the data-isolation service id, [code]api_key[/code] is the per-user key obtained from [code]POST /v1/request-api-key[/code], and [code]user_id[/code] is the gateway identity string in the form [code]"<9-char-id> <display name>"[/code].

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears the configuration back to defaults ([member use_ssl] = [code]true[/code], [member timeout] = 15) and drops any queued or in-flight requests. Useful on logout or when switching accounts.

method.name: list_leaderboards
method.description: Queues a request for the list of active boards for the configured service. Emits [signal leaderboards_received] with an [Array] of board-metadata dictionaries ([code]key[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]description[/code], [code]sortOrder[/code], [code]operator[/code], [code]period[/code], [code]visibility[/code]).

method.name: request_submit_token
method.description: Queues a request for a short-lived HMAC submit token for [code]board_key[/code]. Only needed for boards configured with [code]requireToken = true[/code]. Emits [signal submit_token_received] with the token string and its lifetime in seconds; pass the token to [method submit_score].

method.name: submit_score
method.description: Queues a score submission to [code]board_key[/code] for the configured user. [code]metadata[/code] is free-form client display data. [code]context[/code] is a free-form blob persisted server-side for later anti-cheat auditing (e.g. a run hash). [code]token[/code] is required only for token-gated boards (see [method request_submit_token]). Emits [signal score_submitted] with the caller's own private-safe view: [code]{rank, score, numScore, total, periodKey}[/code]. How [code]score[/code] combines with any existing entry is decided by the board's operator (best / set / incr / decr). Scores outside the board's plausibility bounds are silently shadow-flagged by the server (hidden from public reads) and still return a normal response.

method.name: get_rank
method.description: Queues a request for the configured user's own rank on [code]board_key[/code], plus [code]around[/code] neighbors above and below (0 = just the rank). Works on any board regardless of visibility — the private-safe default. Emits [signal rank_received] with [code]{rank, score, total, entries}[/code]; [code]rank[/code] is [code]null[/code] if the user has no entry yet, and each neighbor row carries an [code]isYou[/code] flag on the caller's own entry.

method.name: get_top
method.description: Queues a request for the browsable top-N of [code]board_key[/code]. Only permitted on boards whose visibility is [code]public[/code]; other boards fail with [signal request_failed] code [code]403[/code]. [code]period_key[/code] selects an explicit period bucket (e.g. [code]"2026-W32"[/code]); leave empty for the current period. [code]limit[/code] caps the page size and [code]cursor[/code] continues a previous page. Emits [signal top_received] with the ranked [code]entries[/code] and a [code]next_cursor[/code] (empty when there are no more pages).

method.name: get_distribution
method.description: Queues a request for the score distribution of [code]board_key[/code] — percentile thresholds and a histogram with [b]no player names[/b], so outlier/cheater scores barely move the bands. Emits [signal distribution_received] with [code]{total, yourScore, yourPercentile, thresholds, histogram}[/code], where [code]thresholds[/code] maps [code]"top1"/"top10"/"top25"/"top50"[/code] to score cutoffs and [code]histogram[/code] is an array of [code]{min, max, count}[/code] buckets.

method.name: get_friends
method.description: Queues a request for a ranking of [code]board_key[/code] filtered to [code]friend_ids[/code] (gateway identity strings). The configured user is always included, so they see their own row among friends. No social graph is stored on the server — the client supplies the id set. Emits [signal friends_received] with the ranked [code]entries[/code] (each carrying its global rank and an [code]isYou[/code] flag).

method.name: pump
method.description: Issues any queued actions and polls in-flight requests once. [KomsoftGwNode] calls this every frame; call it yourself only if you drive processing manually.

method.name: pending_count
method.description: Returns the number of requests currently queued plus in flight. Zero when the client is idle.

method.name: set_use_ssl
method.description: Sets whether requests use HTTPS with domain validation. See [member use_ssl].

method.name: get_use_ssl
method.description: Returns whether requests use HTTPS. See [member use_ssl].

method.name: set_timeout
method.description: Sets the per-request timeout in seconds. See [member timeout].

method.name: get_timeout
method.description: Returns the per-request timeout in seconds. See [member timeout].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], requests are made over HTTPS with domain validation. Set to [code]false[/code] for a plain-HTTP local backend during development.
Per-request timeout in seconds. A request that exceeds it completes with a failure and emits [signal request_failed].

signal.name: leaderboards_received
signal.description: Emitted after [method list_leaderboards] succeeds. [code]leaderboards[/code] is an array of board-metadata dictionaries.

signal.name: submit_token_received
signal.description: Emitted after [method request_submit_token] succeeds. [code]expires_in[/code] is the token lifetime in seconds.

signal.name: score_submitted
signal.description: Emitted after [method submit_score] succeeds. [code]result[/code] is the caller's own view: [code]{rank, score, numScore, total, periodKey}[/code].

signal.name: rank_received
signal.description: Emitted after [method get_rank] succeeds. [code]result[/code] is [code]{rank, score, total, entries}[/code].

signal.name: top_received
signal.description: Emitted after [method get_top] succeeds. [code]next_cursor[/code] is empty when there are no further pages.

signal.name: distribution_received
signal.description: Emitted after [method get_distribution] succeeds. [code]result[/code] is [code]{total, yourScore, yourPercentile, thresholds, histogram}[/code].

signal.name: friends_received
signal.description: Emitted after [method get_friends] succeeds. [code]entries[/code] is the ranked subset for the supplied friend ids.

signal.name: request_failed
signal.description: Emitted when any request fails. [code]endpoint[/code] identifies the call (e.g. [code]"submit"[/code], [code]"top"[/code]), [code]code[/code] is the HTTP status (or 0 for transport/timeout errors), and [code]message[/code] is a human-readable reason. A [code]401[/code] means the API key is missing or invalid for the configured user/service; [code]403[/code] on [method get_top] means the board is not public.

constants.constant: Ascending sort — lower scores rank first (e.g. speedrun times).
Descending sort — higher scores rank first (e.g. high scores).
Keep the best score per player (per the board's sort order).
Always overwrite with the latest submitted score.
Add each submission to the player's running total.
Subtract each submission from the player's running total.
A single all-time ranking that never resets.
